newsitem.title: USA: ITT to acquire Goulds Pumps for $815 million.
newsitem.headline: ITT to acquire Goulds Pumps for $815 million.

text.p: ITT Industries Inc. and Goulds Pumps Inc. said Monday they approved a definitive agreement for ITT to acquire Goulds for $37 a share, or about $815 million in cash, plus assumption of $119 million of debt.

ITT, a widely diversified manufacturer of industrial products, will become a leading global supplier of industrial, residential and commercial pumps with the acquisition of Goulds, which is based in Fairport, N.Y.
Goulds Pumps is a worldwide supplier of industrial, residential and commercial pumps, parts and accessories. The company had 1996 revenues of $774 million and employs more than 5,200 people.

"On the revenue side, the products of ITT Industries' fluid technology business and Goulds complement each other perfectly," said Travis Engen, chairman ITT. "For example, Goulds is one of the leading producers of pumps for the industrial sector while ITT Industries is a world leader in submersible pumps for municipal water treatment worldwide."
ITT said it expects the acquisition to enhance earnings growth, "with an accretive impact in its first full year and significant contributions thereafter."
The cost benefits available in this combination flow from greater economies in purchasing, manufacturing, marketing and sales, R&D and support functions, ITT said.
A cash tender offer will be commenced by a wholly owned subsidiary of ITT Industries no later than April 25 to acquire all of the outstanding shares of Goulds, the companies said.

The tender offer will be subject to the valid tender of Goulds' shares representing a majority of the voting power of Goulds, the expiration of waiting periods under applicable antitrust and competition laws, and other customary closing conditions, ITT said.
The tender offer is expected to be completed in June, ITT said.
